summary: Phase 4 Local Events feature testing complete. All 27 backend tests passed (100%). Frontend admin panel Events tab fully functional with all CRUD operations, settings controls, and UI elements working correctly. Lobby display shows events in slideshow rotation. All 6 admin tabs verified working (Images, Attractions, Events, Content, Settings, Display). Regression tests for Phase 1-3 features passed.

Backend: GET /api/events?sort_by=upcoming returns events sorted by date
Backend: GET /api/events?sort_by=featured returns featured events first
Backend: GET /api/events?sort_by=newest returns newest first
Backend: GET /api/events?include_expired=true returns all events including expired
Backend: POST /api/events creates new event with all fields (title, description, event_date, start_time, end_time, location, address, category, website, phone, notes, featured)
Backend: PUT /api/events/{id} updates event fields
Backend: PUT /api/events/{id} toggles featured flag
Backend: PUT /api/events/{id} toggles enabled flag
Backend: DELETE /api/events/{id} removes an event
Backend: DELETE /api/events/{id} returns 404 for nonexistent event
Backend: POST /api/events/reorder accepts list of IDs and updates order
Backend: Events have is_expired field computed from event_date
Backend: Auto-hide expired events when events_auto_hide_expired is true
Backend: keep_after_expired flag overrides auto-hide for individual events
Backend: GET /api/settings returns events_per_slide, events_auto_rotate, events_show_in_slideshow, events_auto_hide_expired, events_sort_by
Backend: PUT /api/settings saves events_per_slide
Backend: PUT /api/settings saves events_auto_rotate
Backend: PUT /api/settings saves events_show_in_slideshow
Backend: PUT /api/settings saves events_auto_hide_expired
Backend: PUT /api/settings saves events_sort_by (all options: upcoming, newest, featured, custom)
Backend: Phase 1 endpoints still work (health, images, settings, news)
Backend: Phase 2 endpoints still work (attractions, content)
Frontend: Admin panel loads with 6 tabs (Images, Attractions, Events, Content, Settings, Display)
Frontend: Events tab loads with event list, add button, settings row
Frontend: Events tab has events-per-slide-input control
Frontend: Events tab has events-auto-rotate-toggle control
Frontend: Events tab has events-show-in-slideshow-toggle control
Frontend: Events tab has events-auto-hide-expired-toggle control
Frontend: Events tab has events-sort-select dropdown
Frontend: Add Event button opens new event form
Frontend: New event form has all fields (title, description, date, times, location, address, category, website, phone, notes, featured)
Frontend: Save Event creates new event and adds to list
Frontend: Edit event button opens inline edit form with all fields
Frontend: Toggle event enabled/disabled works

test_credentials: No authentication required. Admin panel at /admin is open access.
seed_data_creation: 4 default events seeded: Norwegian Heritage Festival (featured), Farmers Market, Live Music (featured), Spring Trail Hike. Test events created during testing were cleaned up.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Phase 4 Local Events feature complete. Admin Events tab has: events-per-slide-input, events-auto-rotate-toggle, events-show-in-slideshow-toggle, events-auto-hide-expired-toggle, events-sort-select. Event items have data-testid='event-item-{id}', edit-event-{id}, delete-event-{id}, toggle-event-{id}, feature-event-{id}. New event form: new-event-form, new-event-title, new-event-description, new-event-date, new-event-start-time, new-event-category, save-new-event. LobbyDisplay.jsx fetches from /api/events and passes to EventsSlide component. EventsSlide shows featured events in grid, other events in smaller cards with category-based gradient colors.

events_sorting.custom: Working - uses order field from reorder
